interest_rule: Simple interest during course and moratorium; interest servicing is optional. Unpaid accrued interest is added to principal for EMI calculation. Floating rate.

interest_rule: 3% interest subvention on eligible loans up to INR 1000000 for families with annual income up to INR 800000 during moratorium. Separate full interest subvention may apply to eligible families with income up to INR 450000 under applicable guidelines.

interest_rule: Simple interest during study and moratorium. Interest servicing is optional; unpaid accrued interest is added to principal when EMI is fixed. Margin varies by loan amount and study location.

scheme: PM-USP Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme (CSIS)

interest_rule: Simple interest during repayment holiday. Accrued interest during the holiday is added to principal for EMI calculation. Interest rate varies by institution category and applicable bank terms.

interest_rule: Floating rate linked to EBR. Accrued interest during course and moratorium is added to principal unless serviced before repayment begins. The INR 750000 maximum in this record refers to the standard overseas-study limit.

collateral_threshold: Scheme applies to select premier institutions. Security and loan limits depend on the institution category and applicable scheme terms.
interest_rule: Floating interest rate linked to EBR. Applicable rate depends on the selected institution category.

collateral_threshold: No collateral for loans up to INR 750000 under the published scheme.
interest_rule: Floating interest rate linked to EBR. Applicable interest rate and repayment terms depend on the scheme conditions.

collateral_threshold: Security-free limits vary by institution category: INR 4000000 for List AA, INR 3000000 for List A, INR 1500000 for List B and INR 1000000 for List C.
interest_rule: Interest rate depends on applicable bank terms. Repayment holiday interest treatment should be verified from the latest MITC.

scheme: Baroda Education Loan for Premier Institutions

interest_rule: Interest rate depends on institution category and applicable bank terms.

interest_rule: Floating rate linked to RLLR. Published rate information identifies this as a loan scheme with a limit of INR 750000.

interest_rule: Special scheme for select premier institutions in India. Interest rates vary by institution category.
